Auto-capture with
browser extension

Capture anything from the webpages, Google Docs, or YouTube videos. remio automatically saves valuable information while intelligently filtering out sensitive content.

Turn your recordings into actionable assets

Unlimited free for recoding and transcription

Enjoy transcription and AI overview for online and offline meetings, lectures, and other recordings.

All the sparkling ideas in discussions are now searchable and chatable in remio.

Freeing you to focus on thinking, not noting.

Local folder & file indexing,
easy & secure

remio streamlines local info capture by indexing with your files—no uploads needed. Use it as a smart file explorer or a central hub for managing your local knowledge.

Connect your inbox,
never lose the thread again

Unlock the value in your emails with remio. Transform client communications, project decisions, and newsletters directly into

searchable knowledge assets.

Bridge your messages and knowledge base

remio now works with Slack!

Integrate Slack workspaces and turn daily conversations into a living, searchable hub of insights, right where you work.

Privacy is our top priority

Your knowledge is yours, and yours alone.

All captured information is securely stored on your local device.
